title: Best Banana Bread
description: Super-moist and buttery with rich banana and brown sugar flavors and an ultra-soft crumb. An undeniably popular recipe from Sally's Baking Addiction.
author: Sally McKenney

ingredients.name: Packed light or dark brown sugar
Unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
Plain Greek yogurt or sour cream, room temperature
Chopped pecans, walnuts, or chocolate chips (optional)

steps: Adjust your oven rack to the lower third position and preheat to 350°F (177°C). Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour ({flour}), baking soda ({baking_soda}), salt ({salt}), and ground cinnamon ({cinnamon}). Set aside.

In a large bowl using an electric hand mixer or stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the softened butter ({butter}) and brown sugar ({sugar}) on medium-high speed until light and creamy (about 3 minutes).
With the mixer running on medium speed, add the eggs ({eggs}) one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat in the mashed bananas ({bananas}), Greek yogurt or sour cream ({yogurt}), and vanilla extract ({vanilla}) until combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and beat on low speed just until combined—do not overmix. Gently fold in the nuts or chocolate chips ({add_ins}), if using.
Pour and spread the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Bake at 177°C (350°F) for 60–65 minutes, loosely covering with foil halfway through to prevent over-browning.

The bread is done when a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean with only a few moist crumbs. Cool in the pan on a wire rack for 1 hour, then remove from the pan to cool completely before slicing.
